configuration: Nikon ECLIPSE Ts2-FL routine inverted stand, CFI60 optics, TS2-W10X eyepieces, TS2-S-SM mechanical stage with C-S-HS slide holder, T1-SNCP precentered phase slider, 10XF and LWD 20XF ADL objectives, one 470 nm epi LED and C-LED470 cube, and an operator shielding plate. The optional TS2-P-CF side port carries a DS-Fi3 through the C-0.63X-TS2 relay.

views.title: Operator view and camera
views.caption: The oblique manual drawing places the lateral camera port beside the oculars, the coarse/fine knobs low on the base, and the DIA/EPI switches on its front. The DS-Fi3 head is the accessory selected for this reconstruction.
views.sourceLabel: Nikon M700 E, p. 1, Ts2-FL with camera port

views.title: Lateral profile
views.caption: The side drawing fixes the 200 mm stage elevation, the location of the coaxial focus control and the 45° viewing tube. The rear upright leans toward the optical axis, leaving the stage accessible.

views.title: Stage, slide and objective
views.caption: The removable slide holder sits on the mechanical carriage. The optical axis passes through the objective below the slide and the ELWD condenser above. Both lenses use the Ph1 annulus. The amber operator shield is included as an accessory; its shade and profile are approximate.
views.sourceLabel: Nikon M700 E, p. 2, Ts2-FL component diagram

views.title: Rear housing and power inlet
views.caption: The small rear view locates the AC inlet low on the housing. The right-side view identifies the fluorescence brightness control; the illumination source sits within the stand. Connector recesses and housing radii are inferred.

limits: The register’s Ts2F designation is resolved to Nikon’s Ts2-FL routine model. The Ts2R-FL belongs to Nikon’s separately documented research series.

Published exterior dimensions constrain the stand. The drawings and product photographs supply component locations. Internal optical prescriptions, shell fillets, camera adapter length and small connector recesses are approximate.

The references establish the hardware and nominal sensor sampling. No calibrated physical acquisition was available to establish absolute contrast, focus response or fluorescence yield. The calculation places the specimen at an ideal object plane and omits cover-glass aberration. Nikon rates these ADL objectives primarily for phase contrast and identifies visible-light fluorescence as possible with a qualification; the synthetic signal does not characterize collection efficiency.
